d:
Join Veggie Paaji on Episode 3 of the Patna Food Series! We're diving deep into the historic streets of Patna City to uncover some of its most legendary and hidden culinary gems.
In this food tour, we start at the bustling Chowk vegetable market to taste the iconic kachoris from 'Nandu Lal kachori wale.' Then, we head to 'Tandon's Samosa And Sweets' for a unique samosa you won't find anywhere else—filled with paneer!
